title: SqlServerContainerFixture InitializeAsync fails because Ryuk image pull from netaspireci.azurecr.io is refused (connection refused)
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire... / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
error_pattern: Class fixture type 'Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests.SqlServerContainerFixture' threw in InitializeAsync ---- Docker.DotNet.DockerApiException : Docker API responded with status code=InternalServerError, response={"message":"Head \"https://netaspireci.azurecr.io/v2/testcontainers/ryuk/manifests/0.14.0\": dial tcp 20.150.241.5:443: connect: connection refused"}
analysis: All 7 failing tests in this job fail identically in class fixture InitializeAsync while trying to pull the Testcontainers Ryuk image from the internal container registry netaspireci.azurecr.io. The error is a raw TCP connection refusal to the registry's IP address, which is an external network/infrastructure dependency completely outside the PR's control. The PR only modifies CI skip-pattern configuration and test-trigger-map files, none of which touch Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests or SqlServerContainerFixture.
